After kept every fact Before held: spec read before ledger, wording file read before each commit, ledger staged explicitly, exactly one commit, clean status, no return file, and the reply limited to the decision line. To keep this, retain the explicit statement that `returned:` takes the saved pending tuple verbatim with nothing appended and that the count lives only in `iterations:`, and keep the return-file instruction scoped to outside-ledger rows so home iterations continue not to create one.
